reviews.title: fast shipping dependable CPU!
reviews.comment: came just in time it was packed very nicely since it did not have the original box was really worried about the packaging but was really surprised to see the amount of packing around the CPU it is very stable after using it for a good week of heavy work with video editing and gaming its a good mid tier CPU. with cooling stays well at 60c with some gaming as high as 75 with heavy video editing. speeds up to 4.7GHz 10core. functionality good. and for stability is very good have not had any problems so far! very happy with this product and the price as well will buy again from this seller

reviews.author: Ethan

reviews.title: I love it. Stable, quiet, fast, affordable.
reviews.comment: Upgraded from an i7 9700F and the i5 14400F performs a lot better than I expected. The price can't be beat and I noticed around an average of 25+fps higher in most games but all games and apps RUN SMOOTHER. It FEELS smoother to use my PC and that is what I freaking wanted. Excellent CPU and it runs cool. 67C during gaming with a inexpensive after market air cooler. Thank you! 😍
